_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper. Photonics-assisted W-band (100 GHz) FiWi ISAC using OTFS modulation and Zero-Padding 2D-DFT for enhanced resolution.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: DSP block diagram showing OTFS Tx/Rx. Fig 3: Setup with 50km Fiber + 3.2m Wireless. Fig 8/9: Ranging resolution improvement with ZP-2D-DFT.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: W-band FiWi ISAC. Waveform: OTFS (Orthogonal Time Frequency Space) - single waveform for both Comm & Sensing. Processing: ZP-2D-DFT to improve ranging beyond standard OFDM/OTFS resolution limits.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 5.44 Gbps (16QAM). Sensing: 1.58 cm resolution (0.36 ns pulse width). Dist: 50 km Fiber + 3.2 m Wireless.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: OTFS offers better robustness to frequency-selective fading than OFDM in W-band. ZP-2D-DFT is a purely digital enhancement to sensing resolution.

bibliographic.title: Zero-Padding 2D-DFT Scheme for Photonics-Assisted W-Band Fiber-Wireless ISAC System With Orthogonal Time Frequency Space Modulation
bibliographic.authors: Jing He, Lede Yin, Kang Liu, Shijie Xiao, Zuo Chen

application.scenario_description: W-band Fiber-Wireless link for simultaneous high-speed access and high-precision ranging/positioning.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Proposal of OTFS waveform for W-band FiWi ISAC and a Zero-Padding 2D-DFT scheme to improve ranging resolution from 11cm to 1.58cm.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Low ranging resolution of standard DFT processing in ISAC and frequency-selective fading sensitivity of OFDM.

identification.scenario_label: W-Band FiWi OTFS ISAC with ZP-2D-DFT

transmitter.notes: ECL @ 192.723 THz + 192.824 THz (Heterodyne). 100 GHz carrier. 1.36 GHz Signal Bandwidth.

receiver.notes: Envelope Detector (ED) used at wireless receiver/sensing receiver.

integration.notes: Single OTFS waveform used for both.

comm_metrics.notes: Net data rate 5.44 Gbps. 1.18 dB gain over OFDM.

sensing_metrics.notes: Theoretical resolution improved to 1.58 cm using ZP-2D-DFT (from 11 cm). Error 0.36 cm.

tradeoff.notes: ZP-2D-DFT increases computational time linearly with Zero-Padding factor (Ar).
